title: Memory Sleep (Consolidation)
description: Trigger AEGIS memory consolidation sleep. Use this when the user says things like 'sleep', 'go to sleep', 'sleep now', '睡眠して', '寝て', or asks AEGIS to organize memories. This starts SleepManager and lets it consolidate memories, lessons, action traces, and summaries.

examples.user: go to sleep and consolidate memories
